packageRules.description: Formula/squeezy.rb is owned by squeezy's .github/workflows/update-homebrew-tap.yml, which rewrites url + sha256 on every v* tag and regenerates the Python resource blocks with `brew update-python-resources`. Renovate can only bump the top-level url, so letting it near this file means racing the release workflow and leaving the resource blocks stale. Renovate stays enabled for everything else in the tap.
